;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**Over 120 rebels are killed in northwestern [[Hama Governorate]], after failed attacks against [[Syrian Arab Army|Syrian troops]]. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/syrian-army-killed-120-militants-during-hts-offensive-in-nw-hama-russia/ (''Al-Masdar News'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**Authorities arrested Ashiqul Alam who allegedly planned to attack [[Times Square]] in [[New York City]] with [[Grenade|grenades]], [[Gun|guns]] and a [[Explosive belt|suicide vest]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/07/nyregion/times-square-plot-attack.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/07/opinions/terrorist-plots-new-york-los-angeles-isis-campbell/index.html (CNN)]

;Art and culture
*[[France]] returns three archaeological pieces to [[Peru]] that were seized by French customs in 2007. The artifacts, which date from between 1100 and 1450, are two clay statuettes and a wooden spear that belong to the [[Chancay culture|Chancay]] and [[Chimú culture|Chimú]] pre-Columbian cultures respectively. [https://peru21.pe/peru/francia-devuelve-piezas-precolombinas-confiscadas-2007-482827 (''Perú.21'')] [https://elcomercio.pe/peru/francia-devuelve-peru-tres-piezas-prehispanicas-confiscadas-culturas-chancay-chimu-fotos-noticia-nndc-642424 (''El Comercio'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representatives]] [[Peter DeFazio]] and [[Rick Larsen]] of the [[United States House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure|House Transportation committee]] report Boeing discovered the 737 Max AOA  Disagree alert problem in 2017 but decided to defer fixing it until 2020,  and sped up the process only after the [[Lion Air Flight 610]] crash.  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-boeing-737/boeing-delayed-fix-of-defective-737-max-warning-light-for-three-years-u-s-lawmakers-idUSKCN1T8284?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.seattletimes.com/business/boeing-aerospace/boeing-didnt-plan-to-fix-737-max-warning-light-until-2020/ (''The Seattle Times'')]
*[[Concerns over Chinese involvement in 5G wireless networks]],  [[Brazil-China relations]]
**[[Brazil]]ian Vice President [[Hamilton Mourão]]  says the government will not exclude [[China|Chinese]] telecom company [[Huawei|Huawei Technologies Co.]] from operating a [[5G|fifth-generation (5G)]] mobile telecom network. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-huawei-tech-brazil/brazil-will-not-bar-huawei-from-5g-network-vice-president-idUSKCN1T82BJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Hydraulic fracturing]]
**[[Colombia]]’s top administrative court begins hearings on proposals to drill for oil using the technique known as fracking. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-fracking/colombia-tribunal-begins-hearing-evidence-on-use-of-fracking-idUSKCN1T82BX?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An [[Oman]]-registered bus carrying 31 passengers crashes into an overhead [[traffic sign]] in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], killing at least 17 people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-48553559 (BBC News)]
*[[2018–19 European windstorm season]]
**Three people on a  rescue mission are killed when [[2018–19 European windstorm season#Storm Miguel|Storm Miguel]], with max winds of  129 km/h (80 mph), overturned their [[Société Nationale de Sauvetage en Mer|National Society of Sea Rescue]] boat off the west coast of [[France]] in the Atlantic Ocean.  The  storm, unusual at the start of the summer tourist season, hit Spain, the [[Netherlands]] and southern England and Wales yesterday and is heading north toward  [[England]], Wales and Scotland. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48553351 (BBC News)] [https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/storm-miguel-to-bring-wet-windy-weather-to-uk-on-friday-and-saturday/70008466 (AccuWeather)]

;Health and environment
*In the [[United Kingdom]], three hospital patients die from ''[[listeria]]'' linked to prepacked sandwiches from North Country Cooked Meats distributed via The Good Food Chain, which supplies 43 [[National Health Service]] trusts across the country. Three other patients are seriously ill. North Country Cooked Meats, and its distributor, North Country Quality Foods, voluntarily cease production while the investigation is ongoing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-48557421 (BBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/07/health/three-dead-listeria-contaminated-sandwiches-intl-scli-gbr/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*The U.S. cruiser [[USS Chancellorsville|USS ''Chancellorsville'']] and the [[Russian destroyer Admiral Vinogradov|Russian destroyer ''Admiral Vinogradov'']] almost collide in the western [[Pacific Ocean]]. Each side blames the other, and their reports disagree as to the location of the incident: Russia claims it happened in the [[East China Sea]], while the U.S. says it was in the nearby [[Philippine Sea]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48553568 (BBC News)]
*[[May 2019 Gulf of Oman incident|2019 Gulf of Oman incident]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] tells the UN Security Council that a "state actor" was most likely behind the May 12 attacks on four tankers off its coast, including ones from [[Saudi Arabia]] and [[Norway]]. UAE did not say who it suspected; the [[United States]] blamed [[Iran]] which denied the accusation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48551125 (BBC News)]
*[[Turkey–United States relations]]
**The United States notifies Turkey that it will  cancel Turkey's purchase of [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 fighter]] jets if the government goes ahead with purchasing  Russia's [[S-400 missile system|S-400 missile defense system]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/starts-withdrawing-turkey-35-programme-russia-deal-190607184612902.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mexico–United States relations]]
**[[Mexico]] and the [[United States]] reach a deal on migration, suspending tariffs on Mexican imports into the U.S. which were to take effect on June 10. Mexico agreed to increase its enforcement efforts along their southern border with [[Guatemala]], including deploying troops from their upcoming {{Interlanguage link|Mexican National Guard|lt=National Guard|es|Guardia Nacional de México}}. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-tariff-mexico-president-says-cancels-plan-after-deal-reached-on-immigration-today-2019-06-08/ (CBS News)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/07/read-the-us-mexico-statement-on-immigration-that-averted-trumps-tariffs.html (CNBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Conservative Party leadership election]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] resigns as [[Leader of the Conservative Party (UK)|Leader of the Conservative Party]], paving the way for a new Prime Minister to be elected. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-48497953 (BBC News)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports more than four million Venezuelans have fled their country during the economic and humanitarian crisis. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48559739 (BBC News)]


;Science and technology
*[[NASA]] announces that the [[International Space Station]] will be opened for commercial business in 2020 for $58 million. [https://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-nasa-international-space-station-visitors-20190607-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')] [https://www.space.com/nasa-international-space-station-commercial-use.html (Space.com)]

;Sports
*The [[2019 FIFA Women's World Cup]] starts with the hosts [[France women's national football team|France]] defeating [[South Korea women's national football team|South Korea]] 4–0. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-worldcup-fra-kor-report/rampant-france-thrash-korea-in-world-cup-opener-idUSKCN1T82ED (Reuters)]
